content.comment_body: I am using a compact controller with 6 inputs and 4 outputs. I want to synchronize its clock using an external pulse provided through one of the inputs. Is this achievable?

Dear customer, unfortunately, this compact controller does not support clock adjustment through programming or via an external signal (such as DFC77). To achieve this functionality, you would need a different controller model. Sincerely, Technical Support

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to synchronize the clock of a compact controller using an external pulse through its inputs, but learns this is not possible with their current device. Technical support clarifies that clock synchronization via program or external signals is not available for this product, pointing out a key limitation for users needing such capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the compact controller can synchronize its clock using an external pulse received through an input, to allow for accurate timing based on an external source.
